Extract APA-formatted result summaries

Source: R/accessors.R
sframe_apa.Rd

Returns the report-ready sentence attached to each analysis result.

Usage

sframe_apa(x, ...)

Arguments

x

An sframe_analysis_results, sframe_descriptives_report, sframe_missing_data_report, sframe_validity_report, or sframe_assumption_report object.

...

Passed to methods.

Value

A character vector containing one APA-formatted summary per result.

See also

sframe_report_accessors, run_analysis_plan()

Other Inspect functions: as.data.frame.sf_choices(), as.data.frame.sframe(), as.data.frame.sframe_analysis_results(), as.data.frame.sframe_assumption_report(), as.data.frame.sframe_codebook(), as.data.frame.sframe_descriptives_report(), as.data.frame.sframe_efa_report(), as.data.frame.sframe_efa_solution(), as.data.frame.sframe_item_report(), as.data.frame.sframe_missing_data_report(), as.data.frame.sframe_quality_report(), as.data.frame.sframe_reliability_report(), as.data.frame.sframe_sample_size_plan(), as.data.frame.sframe_sensitivity(), as.data.frame.sframe_validation(), as.data.frame.sframe_validity_report(), sf_component_list, sframe_accessors, sframe_as_data_frame(), sframe_flagged(), sframe_get_attention_checks(), sframe_get_branches(), sframe_get_choice_sets(), sframe_get_items(), sframe_get_models(), sframe_get_scales(), sframe_id(), sframe_identity, sframe_is_valid(), sframe_label(), sframe_meta(), sframe_missing_columns(), sframe_notes(), sframe_object(), sframe_problems(), sframe_report_accessors, sframe_subset, sframe_validation_accessors

Examples

results <- structure(
  list(RQ1 = list(apa = "Mean satisfaction was 4.20.")),
  class = c("sframe_analysis_results", "list")
)
sframe_apa(results)
#>                           RQ1 
#> "Mean satisfaction was 4.20."
